<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (child)*>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % ent "<!ENTITY internal 'parsed data'>">
  %ent;
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <!ENTITY ext SYSTEM "logo.png" NDATA png>
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="style.xsl"?>
<root xmlns="http://example.org/ns1" xmlns:ns2="http://example.org/ns2">
  <!-- Primary comment containing entity reference &internal; and CDATA marker -->
  <ns2:child id="id1">
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA block with markup <tag>&internal;</tag> inside.
    ]]>
  </ns2:child>
  <child>&internal;</child>
</root>
```

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (item*)>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY base "RootEntity">
  <!ENTITY extended "&base;Extended">
  <!NOTATION pdf SYSTEM "application/pdf">
  <!ENTITY manual SYSTEM "manual.pdf" NDATA pdf>
  <!ENTITY % paramDTD "<!ELEMENT metadata (#PCDATA)>">
  %paramDTD;
]>
<?xml-model href="schema.rng" type="application/xml-relax-ng"?>
<catalog xmlns="http://example.com/catalog" xmlns:xi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XInclude">
  <!-- Catalog level comment -->
  <metadata>
    <![CDATA[
      Some metadata info with <tag> and &extended;
    ]]>
  </metadata>
  <item>&extended;</item>
</catalog>
```

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE doc [
  <!ELEMENT doc (section+)>
  <!ELEMENT section (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY ent1 "First">
  <!ENTITY ent2 "&ent1; and Second">
  <!ENTITY % pEnt "<!ENTITY ent3 'ParameterExpanded'>">
  %pEnt;
]>
<?xml-target processing-instruction-data="value"?>
<doc xmlns="http://example.org/doc" xmlns:custom="http://example.org/custom">
  <!-- Comment in document root -->
  <custom:section id="s1">
    <![CDATA[
      Special CDATA section containing &ent2; and <custom:section>
    ]]>
  </custom:section>
  <section>&ent3;</section>
</doc>

  <!ELEMENT archive (record*)>

  <!ENTITY r2 "&r1;&r1;">

  </record>
  <record>&r2;</record>
</archive>
